name: Intelligent Routing
description: Automatic model routing based on task complexity. Classifies incoming messages and routes MEDIUM+ tasks to stronger models, while SIMPLE tasks stay on the default (Haiku). Includes system-context caching, usage tracking, outcome logging, and fixed envelope stripping for Sender metadata blocks.

routingLogPath.description: Absolute path to routing-log.jsonl for logging decisions

enableFastPath.description: Enable keyword-based fast-path for SIMPLE classification (default: true)

dryRun.description: Log routing decisions but don't override the model (default: false)

skipAgents.description: Agent IDs to exclude from routing entirely — no classification, no model override. The agent uses its own default model.
